text:
liz: Heads-up  launching our benchmark narrative next week. Need coordinated X thread, LinkedIn long form, short promo clip, and routing for demo requests. Can we confirm copy + assets by Monday EOD?

omar: I can map the thread. Thinking 5 tweets: hook, why it matters (latency/cost), a concise stat, a short how-we-tested note, CTA to webinar + demo.

tia: Timing proposal: X live Mon 11am PT, LinkedIn post Tues 10am PT, paid promos Wed. Webinar Fri 9am PT. Does that work?

liz: Works. Also want two LinkedIn tones: "data-first" and "operator story". Keep each ~130 words.

maria (growth): For attribution, use utm_source=redwood_social, utm_medium=x_or_linkedin, utm_campaign=benchmark_launch_may. Add utm_term=variant1/variant2 for copy test. Example shortlink: https://rwd.ai/demo?utm_source=redwood_social&utm_medium=x&utm_campaign=benchmark_launch_may&utm_term=variant1

arthur (ops): Surface-level routing question: do we send leads to a pooled queue or route by utm_term? Pooled is simpler but less targeted.

liz: Route by utm_term: variant1 -> AE_North, variant2 -> AE_East. Also set high-intent flag for anyone who clicks "request demo" from the webinar CTA.

omar: Draft X thread copy idea: 1) "New benchmark: smart batching reduces per-token cost by 60% in our tests." 2) "We ran 6 configs across open models + quantized variants 9K requests total." 3) "Top-line: latency impact varies by batch strategy  see chart." 4) "Join our webinar Fri for the deep dive: https://rwd.ai/webinar?utm_source=redwood_social&utm_medium=x&utm_campaign=benchmark_launch_may&utm_term=variant1" 5) "Pinned follow-up w/ chart + TL;DR."

tia: For A/B we'll tweak the hook: variant2 starts with a customer angle: "How an ops team saved X on inference costs  register to watch their story + the benchmark."

maria (growth): I'll set up the GA campaign and create two shortlinks. Also will export CSV mapping utm_term -> AE queue:
```
utm_term,queue_id
variant1,AE_North
variant2,AE_East
```

arthur (ops): I'll wire the form webhook to include utm params and test routing. Need sample test payloads by Tuesday.

liz: Creative requests: hero 1280x720 PNG, 3-frame carousel 1080x1080, and a 20s MP4 with animated chart. Please keep brand lockup in corner.

omar: Creative notes: emphasize the 60% stat in hero headline, but keep copy minimal. For the clip, animate the benchmark bars and fade in CTA at 15s.

tia: Scheduler ask: can we queue the X thread as a threaded post (manual link in first tweet) and schedule 2 follow-up replies at +30m and +3h with prompts to join webinar? Also pin the initial tweet for 24h.

arthur (ops): Yes to scheduling and pin. We can also set a lightweight auto-reply for mentions pointing to the webinar link. Need approved templates.

liz: Reply templates: A) "Thanks! Want a quick demo? Book here: <shortlink>" B) "Weve got a webinar Fri where we dive into this  join: <shortlink>" Keep it personal.

maria (growth): Also recommend capturing top 30 engaged handles in the first 12h for SDR outreach. We'll prioritize orgs that match our ICP.

omar: I'll draft the LinkedIn long copy variants tonight and post for review in drive.

arthur (ops): I'll run a staging submit to confirm webhook + routing by Tue noon.

tia: Creative ETA: assets uploaded Wed 9am PT.

maria (growth): I'll hand off shortlinks + CSV by Tue 4pm PT.

scheduler-bot: Scheduled: X thread (1730110000), LinkedIn post (1730180000).

liz: One more: paid copy two 1-liners for promote: A) "Benchmark: cut per-token cost up to 60% with smarter batching  watch our webinar." B) "See the test that changed our inference playbook  join the live session Fri."

omar: I'll A/B both on creative and headline.

liz: Great. If no blockers, we'll lock everything Monday morning and push live per schedule. Thanks team. :raised_hands:
